mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, biz_domain_id, first_operation_permission_id, second_operation_permission_id, resource_type_value, created_by, updated_by, deleted_by, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at, delete_flag FROM permission_conflict_rule WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND delete_flag = 0 AND (resource_type_value IS NULL OR resource_type_value = #{resourceTypeValue}) ORDER BY biz_domain_id NULLS FIRST, id ASC

SELECT conflict_rule_id, abstract_user_id, abstract_role_id, biz_domain_id, resource_entity_id, resource_type_value, first_operation_permission_id, second_operation_permission_id, CASE WHEN subject_type = 'USER' THEN 'USER owns conflicting operations ' || first_operation_permission_id || ' and ' || second_operation_permission_id ELSE 'ROLE owns conflicting operations ' || first_operation_permission_id || ' and ' || second_operation_permission_id END AS description FROM (
) violation ORDER BY CASE WHEN subject_type = 'USER' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, COALESCE(abstract_user_id, 9223372036854775807), COALESCE(abstract_role_id, 9223372036854775807), resource_entity_id, conflict_rule_id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
